name: Two Sum (Sorted Array)
description:
Given a 1-indexed sorted array of integers `numbers` and a target integer `target`, find two numbers such that they add up to `target`.

Return the indices of the two numbers, [index1, index2], as a 1-indexed integer slice of length 2.

Your solution must use only O(1) auxiliary space.
hints: Because the array is sorted, you can use two pointers: `left := 0` and `right := len(numbers) - 1`.
If sum == target, return []int{left+1, right+1} (1-indexed). If sum < target, increment left. If sum > target, decrement right.
